description: The observed MeltStealer `information.txt` starts with the emoji-marked `MeltStealer - Report` banner, followed by system, network, browser-count, software, device, and file-grabber sections. This sample is available for manual comparison but is not an active fingerprint.
name: MeltStealer
targets: Browser cookies, autofill, history, bookmarks, downloads,
Process lists and selected registry values
System fingerprint (CPU, RAM, OS version, IP, ISP, ASN)
Windows product key, screenshots, webcam captures
